title: Point Processes and Gap Statistics for Translation Surfaces
summary: We study the behavior of saddle connection directions on translation surfaces from the point process viewpoint. We define a direction point process for saddle connections of length at most $R>0$ on every translation surface. Given a general ergodic $\mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb R)$-invariant measure $μ$ on a stratum of translation surfaces, we also define a slope point process associated with $μ$. By utilizing the dynamics and geometry of strata, we show that for almost every translation surface, the direction point processes, rescaled by $R^2$, converge in distribution to the slope point process…
